pkgmetadata.longdescription: Battleship-TUI is a terminal implementation of the classic Battleship game written in C#. Upstream publishes self-contained, NativeAOT, single-file executables for Linux amd64 and arm64 via GitHub Releases, built by their own public tag-triggered CI; this package installs those binaries as-is rather than building from source. It is an unrelated, independent implementation from games-misc/tui-battleship (the Bash TUI Battleship game).
